harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication across the 3-node RHEL 9 cluster: node1 is the writable primary, node2 and node3 are read-only async standbys built via pg_basebackup -R. Verified writes on node1 propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving changed boot identity via /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id and confirming replication/read-only status recovered after each restart, including a fresh write-then-replicate check after the primary's restart.
actions_performed: Inspected all 3 nodes: RHEL 9.8, no PostgreSQL pre-installed
Installed postgresql-server/postgresql (v13.23) on node1, node2, node3
Populated /etc/hosts with CLUSTER_HOSTS on all nodes
Initialized PostgreSQL data directory on node1 with postgresql-setup --initdb
Configured postgresql.conf on node1: listen_addresses='*', wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders=10, max_replication_slots=10, hot_standby=on, wal_keep_size=512
Created a 'replicator' role with REPLICATION LOGIN on node1, generated password on the node via openssl rand
Configured pg_hba.conf on node1 to allow scram-sha-256 replication/general connections from node2 and node3
Enabled and started postgresql on node1; opened firewalld port 5432/tcp
Diagnosed and fixed a password_encryption=[REDACTED] vs pg_hba scram-sha-256 mismatch that caused 'no valid SCRAM secret' auth failures; set password_encryption=[REDACTED], reset replicator password
Cleared /var/lib/pgsql/data on node2 and node3, ran pg_basebackup -R against node1 to seed standbys with primary_conninfo and standby.signal
Opened firewalld port 5432/tcp, enabled and started postgresql on node2 and node3
Verified pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both standbys 'streaming', and pg_is_in_recovery()=true on node2/node3
Created/inserted/verified a test table on node1 replicates to node2 and node3, and confirmed standbys reject INSERTs (read-only), then dropped the test table
Removed temporary replication password file from node1

Executed mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id + health baseline on all 3 nodes, restarted node2 then node3 (standbys) then node1 (primary) one at a time via backgrounded 'sudo reboot', polled each until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed on each, confirmed postgresql service active and recovery/replication state healthy after each restart
After node1 (primary) restart, re-verified both standbys reconnected as 'streaming' and did a fresh insert-then-replicate check across node2 and node3, then cleaned up the verification table

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as writable primary with replication settings and replicator role
evidence.summary: postgresql.conf replication settings applied, pg_hba.conf updated for scram-sha-256, replicator role created with valid SCRAM secret

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 configured as read-only standbys via pg_basebackup
evidence.summary: pg_basebackup -R succeeded on both nodes, generating standby.signal and primary_conninfo pointing at node1

evidence.requirement: Standbys are actively streaming and read-only
evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both node2/node3 in 'streaming' state; pg_is_in_recovery() returns true on both standbys

evidence.requirement: Changes committed on primary are visible on both standbys
evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 (repl_test) observed on node2 and node3; standbys reject INSERT with 'read-only transaction' error

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 9feeb0bb.../streaming captured; reboot triggered; post-restart boot_id b99a2f09... (changed) confirmed with postgresql active and pg_is_in_recovery=true

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5161af9e.../streaming captured; reboot triggered; post-restart boot_id 413ea4d8... (changed) confirmed with postgresql active and pg_is_in_recovery=true

evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery, and cluster-wide re-verification
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 55595e92... with both standbys streaming captured; both standbys re-confirmed streaming pre-restart; reboot triggered; post-restart boot_id c051c6a9... (changed) confirmed; both standbys reconnected as streaming; fresh insert on node1 (repl_verify) verified present on both node2 and node3 post-restart
